purpose: Universal Foundation research staging for current and future products. MAKE MONEY is one consumer, not the storage boundary.
rules: Fixed fields and the DEEP checklist are minimum search targets, never an allow-list.
Preserve materially relevant out-of-profile findings as observations.
Separate Universal facts from product-specific derived analysis.
Do not coerce missing values to zero.
Keep reported, observed, estimated, inferred and unknown distinct.
Keep found, attempted_unavailable, not_attempted, not_applicable and unknown distinct.
Keep occurred_at, published_at, observed_at and retrieved_at distinct.
Do not overwrite historical facts with newer values; append new metrics/events/evidence.
Deduplicate by entity_id, canonical name, aliases and domains before creating new entities.
Never edit data/entities-index.json from scheduled collection lanes.
Write one new immutable run artifact per execution.
Do not store full large raw web bodies in GitHub staging; store compact evidence metadata, extracted facts, source URLs and locators. Raw archival belongs in R2.
R2/Foundation is the formal source of record after validated ingest.

queue_artifact.format: research-bundle.v1 candidate or array of candidates
